correction_20261031: CORRECTION 2026-10-31 (IT10 P5, independent verification; originals unchanged). (1) The TNK2 family finding (PMID 23686771) is NOT counter-evidence for lowering ACK1: its abstract says the variant abolishes NEDD4 binding and prevents degradation after EGF stimulation and gives no kinase-activity direction; one family; abstract only; the authors call proof pending. (2) PMID 25738261 (abstract) supports ONLY 'ACK1 knockdown raises WWOX in liver-cancer lines' (and an inverse correlation in 150 paired tissues), not the Tyr287 or ubiquitin route; that route rests on PMID 16288044 (abstract only). (3) The repeated ChEMBL dasatinib values (Kd 5.6 and 6.0 nM, IC50 1.0 nM) appear under several documents, several of them 'unknown origin': they are literature values carried between papers, not replicates.
